title: Regular immersions via affine regular quotient charts
statement: Let $a:T\to W$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. A regular immersion is an immersion (a closed immersion into an open subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]) such that every $t\in T$ has an open neighbourhood $V\subseteq T$, a commutative ring $A$, a finite $A$-regular sequence $r$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence], an open immersion $e:\operatorname{Spec}A\to W$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and an isomorphism $q:V\simeq\operatorname{Spec}(A/(r))$ for which $a|_V=e\circ\operatorname{Spec}(A\to A/(r))\circ q$. Here $(r)$ is the ideal generated by the sequence. The sequence may be empty and its length may vary with $t$; no Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.
